title: MCP server 'move in' is live
summary: Your AI agent can now 'move you in' to the LAS or SBS. And it's amazing.
content:
Speaking of MCP servers, our server now has a 'move in' service. Just ask it to help you move in to the Life Admin or Small Business systems and it'll do that. You need at least a Pro account.

It's hard to test this sort of thing without having a bunch of mess to organise. As you might imagine, my laptop's pretty neat. But testing on a realistic sample data set is kinda mind-blowing. It's really good.

Here's a rough-cut video showing the process. This is all in active development, so there's lots more to come.
